capabilities: Filter blocks by tags, text, tasks, quotes, code, tables, images and links
Display matching blocks from multiple notes in a Bases view
Group and sort blocks with standard Bases options
Check off tasks directly in the view
extras: Tag suggestions are marked experimental and may stop appearing after an Obsidian update; style options require the Style Settings plugin.
intentEvidence: Block View is an extension for the Bases core plugin
problem: Bases and search work on whole files, so specific paragraphs, list items, tasks or quotes from many notes cannot be filtered and shown together.

relations.evidence: Block View is an extension for the Bases core plugin
Block View supports configuring some of the styles via the Style Settings plugin.

summary: Bases view that splits notes into blocks and filters them by tags, text, tasks, quotes, code, tables, images and links.
